description.en: Replaces the player-controlled character's current model with a new one for the given body ID: destroys the existing player-controlled model, creates a new manipulated-character model, then re-fetches and returns the player-controlled handle.
Body model ID for the new player character model.
Handle of the newly (re)created player-controlled character model.

example.code:
// Swap the player character's model to a different body
local hTenmaL = ResetEvLowMdlForCharaPlayer(902);
